props.title: Postmortem: webhook-dispatcher retry storm after merchant outage
props.text: INC-2026-031, sev 3. Impact: a large merchant's endpoint was kept down for two hours and kafka-events consumer lag grew. Timeline: after the merchant endpoint recovered from an outage, webhook-dispatcher retried every queued event at once. The burst took the endpoint down again, repeatedly. Root cause: retry storm, with no cap and no jitter on the backoff. Follow-up: MX-655, cap attempts and add …

props.summary: After a merchant endpoint recovered, webhook-dispatcher retried every queued event at once and took it down again. Paused the retry queue and redelivered with capped attempts and jitter.
